column1: # The terms of Overwatch in Japanese and Korean, for TranslateGemma to
# translate as players say them (GLOSSARY_FILE, with TRANSLATOR=translategemma).
# The first line names the languages; then a term a line. The ways of writing
# a term are separated by |, the first being the one to translate into, and
# each is on one line only. A line that starts with # is a note.
# The heroes' and abilities' names are those of the official site, in Japanese
# The ways written after a hero's name are short names and old names, not
# official. The calls and the slang are those players say in voice chat.
ウィドウメイカー|ウィドウ
ジェットパック・キャット
ジャンカー・クイーン|ジャンクイーン|JQ
ソルジャー76|ソルジャー
トールビョーン|トール
ドゥームフィスト|ドゥーム
ライフウィーバー|ウィーバー
レッキング・ボール|ハモンド
# Abilities, of 15 heroes: on each hero's page, the ability at the same place
# in the Japanese and the Korean page.
# コピー and 自爆 are everyday words too, so they are found outside the game.
オルタード・バイタル
ワンパン|ワンショット
